title: Nominal Style
rule: Nominal style favors nouns over verbs in formal writing.

examples.text: We conducted an analysis of the data.
There was a deterioration in relations.
The implementation of reforms proceeded slowly.
They expressed disagreement with the proposal.
The accumulation of evidence was decisive.

practicePrompt: Complete: The ___ (evaluate) of the program took six months.
